body.p: After and . In SchXslt's expand stage of EN 16931 (47.78 x 10^9 instructions after ), node atomization in coercion is the largest coercion cost: 3.19 x 10^9 (6.7 %), in src/xdm_node.c.

item.p: Mechanism: profile first (callgrind on the expand stage, tests/bench/coercion.xq and xmark-all); a general fast path for the common case (an attribute or a text-only element of an untyped tree: one xs:untypedAtomic from the string value, without building a sequence), and whatever else the profile shows in atomization (XPath 4.0, 2.4.2 atomization; XDM 4.0, typed-value).
Owns: src/xdm_node.c, its internal header, the tree's typed value and string value paths (src/arena_tree.c only for those), tests/ for them, tests/bench/.

Done when: before and after in a D-record and the commit messages (instructions and seconds) on the expand stage, coercion.xq and xmark-all; QT4 XP40, XQ40 and XT40 whole: no outcome changes, case by case. Done 2026-10-28 (): a typed value describes its node once; text walks step over attributes by count. SchXslt's expand stage 47.78 to 47.45 x 10^9 instructions, coercion.xq 2.716 to 2.695, xmark-all 8.747 to 8.643; QT4 XP40, XQ40 and XT40 whole: 0 outcomes differ, case by case.
